lines.label: Tax K3 (GST on air transport)
lines.basis: DGCA-CAR-S3-M-II — Statutory taxes and airport charges are refundable on cancellation, non-utilisation or no-show, INCLUDING on promotional and special fares where the basic fare is non-refundable. Obligation attaches to the operating permit (Rule 133A of the Aircraft Rules, 1937), not to fare filing, so it binds this carrier regardless of PSS.

evidence.clause_quote: Cancellation Fees: Domestic: 0-24 (Hours) - INR 3499 or 100% of the airfare charge (whichever is lower) 24-72 (Hours) - INR 2499 or 100% of the airfare charge (whichever is lower) 72 Hours + - INR 2499 or 100% of the airfare charge (whichever is lower). 100% of airfare will be forfieted for any changes or cancellations made within two (2) hours prior to the scheduled time of flight departure. No-Show Penalty: 100% of the airfare will be forfieted. [Terms] effective for bookings made from 20th August 2025 onwards.
evidence.content_verification: VERIFIED: bands, cut-off, cap wording and the carrier-stated effective date were all read back from the preserved copy on 2026-09-08.
evidence.why_it_matches: Carrier QP matches; market DOMESTIC matches; fare family FLEXI matches ['FLEXI']; applicability keyed to BOOKING_DATE (2026-06-10) falls inside this rule's stated window; cancellation at T-120.00h selects its band.
caveats: Corrected 2026-09-08 against the preserved copy. The earlier encoding was wrong in four ways: it stated an effective date of 2026-05-12 (the copy says 'effective for bookings made from 20th August 2025 onwards'), omitted the 0-24h band entirely, recorded the 24-72h fee as uncaptured when the copy states it, and used a 4h cut-off where the copy says two (2) hours.
Fee is 'INR X or 100% of the airfare charge (whichever is lower)', encoded as LESSER_OF with an AIRFARE_100PCT cap — a cheap ticket can never owe more than it cost.
The copy also states a no-show penalty of 100% of the airfare. Not encoded as a band: no-show is outside the passenger-initiated cancellation scope of this rule.
